sonnet.problem: The card asks about Genesis 30:40, where Jacob makes the flock face 'the streaked dark-colored sheep in Laban's flocks'. Stop 2 card 1 has just told that Laban removed every streaked, spotted and dark-colored animal (30:35). The two verses seem to clash, so the card asks about the very detail that looks contradictory.
sonnet.rule: When details seem to clash, like 30,000 men (Joshua 8:3) and about 5,000 (Joshua 8:12), or the text jumps in time, he tells each as the text gives it, in the text's order, without explaining. No choice card asks about it.
